summary:
▶ Strategic HR Business Partner with 15+ years of experience driving people strategy and
organizational effectiveness across EPC, infrastructure, and energy sectors.
▶ Trusted advisor to CXOs and senior leadership, aligning workforce planning, succession
management, and performance strategy with long-term business growth objectives.
▶ Expertise in talent architecture, leading end-to-end hiring up to Vice President level and
strengthening leadership pipelines through data-led recruitment models.
▶ Builder of high-performance cultures, designing learning & development frameworks,
succession plans, and engagement initiatives to improve productivity and retention.
▶ Operationally strong HR leader with ownership of HR governance, including PMS, payroll,
compliance, budgeting, policy formulation, and HR digitization.
▶ Analytics-driven HR professional leveraging dashboards and workforce insights to enable
informed decision-making and process improvement.
▶ Proven change enabler, delivering structured onboarding and leadership communication
platforms to enhance employee experience and alignment.

jobs.role: including goal alignment, mid-year and annual reviews, calibration support, and manager
bullets: ▶ Onboarding, Learning & Capability Building: Designed structured onboarding programs (Buddy Program, 30-60-90 Day Plan), drove TNI, and co-created annual technical and behavioral learning calendars, tracking effectiveness through data-driven assessments. ▶ Engagement, Leadership & Culture: Enabled leadership connect forums, Skip-levels, Coffee with Leaders and masterclasses series while building engagement calendars and recognition frameworks to foster collaboration, trust, and a high-performance culture. ▶ Performance Management (PMS): Led end-to-end Performance Management System cycles including goal alignment, mid-year and annual reviews, calibration support, and manager enablement to drive differentiated performance and merit outcomes.
▶ Strategic Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning: Led end-to-end talent acquisition aligned with workforce plans and evolving business priorities.

▶ End-to-End Recruitment Lifecycle Management: Managed the complete recruitment lifecycle, achieving timely closures and high-quality hiring outcomes. ▶ Hiring Manager Collaboration & Requirement Translation: Partnered with hiring managers to translate manpower requirements into precise role specifications and coordinated interview and evaluation processes.
